title: Book Three · Chapter 195: The Bag He Chooses
story:
At the May household review, Dad puts twelve yuan and Mum eight into the study envelope.

Their two hundred and eighty becomes three hundred. Ronan's five hundred and nineteen and old twenty and a half remain separate.

In June, they make the same payment after another review. The parents now keep three hundred and twenty. All three saved amounts total eight hundred and fifty-nine and a half.

One Saturday, Ronan takes the packing list to the market with Dad.

He needs a larger travel bag for his clothes and bedding. His old cloth book bag will be the small bag he keeps beside him.

At the second-hand stall, he tries two bags. One has a weak handle. The other has strong seams and a flat inside pocket.

He puts a folded cloth bundle inside to try the space. Dad holds one end while Ronan shuts it.

“Enough?” Dad asks.

“For my clothes and the sheets.”

Ronan opens the bag again and checks the inside pocket. He slides his flat hand into it. His fingers reach the bottom without catching on a rough seam.

Dad presses the cloth near one corner.

“Look here too.”

Ronan turns the bag toward the light. The corner is worn, but there is no hole. He runs a finger along the stitches.

The seller waits while they look. Ronan tries the handles once more with the cloth bundle inside. This time Dad lets go, and Ronan carries the whole weight for a few steps.

It pulls on his arm. He puts it down and changes hands.

“The road to the station will feel longer,” Dad says.

“Can you make the station closer?”

“No. I can carry one end.”

Ronan smiles. He opens the bag and gives the test bundle back to the seller. Then he checks that the inside pocket is empty before he asks the price again.

The bag costs six yuan. Ronan pays from his work money and takes it himself.

At another stall, he buys a small basin for two yuan and soap for one. His blanket, sheets, cup, and towel can come from home. The class will provide the basic teaching materials.

Nine yuan has left his work savings. The five hundred and nineteen becomes five hundred and ten. With the other two envelopes, he still has eight hundred and fifty and a half set aside.

At home, Mum looks at the bag seams before she gives it back.

“A useful pocket.”

“For the papers.”

“The cloth case can lie flat there.”

Ronan tries his new birthday case inside. The offer and Anna's private letter are in its two pockets. He takes it out again before he puts the empty bag near the wall.

He has not packed all the books yet.

On the shelf are the five books from the old sale. He chooses one story for the journey. The other four will stay at home.

His birthday book will come too, with the class photo and Leo's address paper inside. He puts both books in his old cloth book bag to check the weight.

The English phrase book goes beside them. He moves Anna's roof bookmark from his application copies into it.

Dad watches him lift the small bag.

“A library?”

“A small one.”

Ronan smiles and puts the books back on the shelf for now. Then he takes the new bag outside and wipes it with a clean cloth before the last afternoon light leaves the yard.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

bedding＝床褥用品；seam＝接缝；basin＝脸盆、用水的小盆；packing list＝行李清单。

## 理解问题

1. 五月和六月哪些钱实际存入？九元行装用品分别是什么、从哪份钱付？
2. 五本旧书、生日书照片地址、书签和旧布袋分别怎样安排？

## 读句子

**The other four will stay at home.**

拆开看：The other four / will stay / at home.

另外四本旧书／将留在／家中。
